import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
lake_urmia = ee.Geometry.Point([45.3, 37.5]).buffer(20000)  # 20km buffer around lake center

date_april_2023 = ['2023-04-01', '2023-04-30']
date_july_2018 = ['2018-07-01', '2018-07-31']

# 2. Cloud masking function for Sentinel-2
def mask_s2_clouds(image):
    qa = image.select('QA60')
    cloud_bit_mask = 1 << 10
    cirrus_bit_mask = 1 << 11
    mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloud_bit_mask).eq(0).And(
        qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrus_bit_mask).eq(0))
    return image.updateMask(mask)

# 3. Data Acquisition for July 2018
col_july_2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') \
    .filterDate(date_july_2018[0], date_july_2018[1]) \
    .filterBounds(lake_urmia) \
    .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) \
    .map(mask_s2_clouds)

size_july_2018 = col_july_2018.size().getInfo()
print(f"July 2018 Images: {size_july_2018}")

if size_july_2018 == 0:
    print("No data for July 2018.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 4. Data Acquisition for April 2023
    col_april_2023 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR') \
        .filterDate(date_april_2023[0], date_april_2023[1]) \
        .filterBounds(lake_urmia) \
        .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 30)) \
        .map(mask_s2_clouds)
    
    size_april_2023 = col_april_2023.size().getInfo()
    print(f"April 2023 Images: {size_april_2023}")
    
    if size_april_2023 == 0:
        print("No data for April 2023.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        # 5. Calculate redness (Red band B4 mean)
        img_july_2018 = col_july_2018.median().select('B4')
        img_april_2023 = col_april_2023.median().select('B4')
        
        # Check pixel counts
        count_july = img_july_2018.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=lake_urmia,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('B4').getInfo()
        
        count_april = img_april_2023.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry=lake_urmia,
            scale=3000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('B4').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Valid Pixels - July 2018: {count_july}, April 2023: {count_april}")
        
        if count_july == 0 or count_april == 0:
            print("No valid pixels after masking.")
            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        else:
            # Calculate mean redness
            red_july_2018 = img_july_2018.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                geometry=lake_urmia,
                scale=3000,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).get('B4').getInfo()
            
            red_april_2023 = img_april_2023.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                geometry=lake_urmia,
                scale=3000,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).get('B4').getInfo()
            
            print(f"Mean Red - July 2018: {red_july_2018:.2f}, April 2023: {red_april_2023:.2f}")
            
            # Validation
            if red_july_2018 is None or red_april_2023 is None:
                print("Calculation failed (None values).")
                print("<answer>C3</answer>")
            elif red_july_2018 < 0 or red_april_2023 < 0 or red_july_2018 > 10000 or red_april_2023 > 10000:
                print("Invalid reflectance values.")
                print("<answer>C3</answer>")
            elif red_july_2018 < red_april_2023:
                print("July 2018 shows lower redness than April 2023.")
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("July 2018 does not show lower redness than April 2023.")
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
